fields.name: benchmark_id
fields.description: Stable primary benchmark identity.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Frozen label code: 1 is malicious and 0 is benign.

fields.name: skill_text
fields.description: Exact frozen Skill text when publicly available; null for the five records whose original text is withheld.

fields.name: text_available
fields.description: Whether exact frozen skill_text is present. False for the five original-withheld records even though public_skill_text is provided.

fields.name: text_redacted
fields.description: True when the public representation is sanitized or contains packaging-level credential redaction. For REDACTED_TEXT records this refers to public_skill_text.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Primary contributing source.

fields.name: source_name
fields.description: Human-readable primary source name.

fields.name: source_ids
fields.description: All contributing source IDs as a typed list.

fields.name: provenance
fields.description: Frozen provenance category.

fields.name: evidence_type
fields.description: Frozen evidence type when available.

fields.name: structural_family_id
fields.description: Malicious structural-family ID; null for benign rows.

fields.name: normalized_hash
fields.description: Frozen normalized identity hash of the original artifact. For redacted records this identifies the frozen original, not the sanitized public representation.

fields.name: exact_hash
fields.description: Frozen exact Skill-text hash of the original artifact. For redacted records this identifies the frozen original, not the sanitized public representation.

fields.name: release_status
fields.description: Public text-release decision: FULL_TEXT or REDACTED_TEXT.

fields.name: source_pointer
fields.description: Public source or project URL; not a local path.

fields.name: attack_categories
fields.description: Harmonized attack display names as a typed list; [] means unmapped.

fields.name: attack_category_codes
fields.description: Stable harmonized attack codes corresponding to attack_categories.

fields.name: impact_categories
fields.description: Derived harmonized impact display names as a typed list; [] means unmapped.

fields.name: impact_category_codes
fields.description: Stable derived impact codes corresponding to impact_categories.

fields.name: text_origin_source_id
fields.description: Source ID for the public text origin when available.

fields.name: public_skill_text
fields.description: Sanitized public text provided only when exact frozen skill_text cannot be released because it contains sensitive credential material. Null for records whose exact skill_text is public.

fields.name: redaction_reason
fields.description: Categorical redaction reason. sensitive_credential_material for the five sanitized records; null otherwise.

fields.name: original_text_withheld
fields.description: True when the exact frozen original text remains withheld. True only for the five credential-bearing records.

fields.name: public_text_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of public_skill_text for sanitized records. Does not replace normalized_hash or exact_hash, which identify the frozen original artifact.

null_policy.skill_text: null only for the five REDACTED_TEXT records whose exact original text is withheld; non-null for FULL_TEXT records.
null_policy.public_skill_text: non-null only for the five REDACTED_TEXT records; null for all FULL_TEXT records so exact text is not duplicated.
null_policy.structural_family_id: null for benign rows; populated for malicious construction-context identities.
null_policy.taxonomy_lists: [] for unmapped identities; list values never serialized as delimiter strings.
null_policy.redaction_reason: sensitive_credential_material for the five sanitized records; null otherwise.

top_level_fields_note: Top-level fields is the union of fields across named configs, including taxonomy-only mapping_provenance. It is not a second primary schema. Use configs.<name>.fields for the contract of each Parquet file.
hash_semantics: normalized_hash and exact_hash identify the frozen original artifact. They are not recomputed from sanitized public_skill_text. public_text_sha256 is an optional hash of the sanitized public representation only.
